note: header -- platform's own interface: logo, app name, settings expand, search box
app navigation sidebar -- operator-defined navigation items: files, favorites, shared with you, shared with others, shared links, system tags, trash bin
file list controls -- view switcher, new file/folder button, upload progress, file action panel; excluding breadcrumb which renders user folder names
file table -- column headers (name, size, modified) with sort controls and select all checkbox, and summary row; excluding the fileList panel with user file entries
file list row favorite action button
file list row select file checkbox and select all checkbox
file list row share action button
file list row menu action button
file list row file size cell -- computed operator-defined value about submitted content
file list row date cell -- computed operator-defined timestamp about submitted content
hidden upload field -- platform upload control
